title: "Quality Control Report"

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(govhr)
```

A full quality control report can be generated by passing all 3 modules into the `generate_qc_report()` function as follows:

```{r generate-report, eval = FALSE}
# Generate the quality control report
generate_qc_report(
  contract_dt = bra_hrmis_contract,
  personnel_dt = bra_hrmis_personnel,
  est_dt = bra_hrmis_est,
  output = "quality_control_report.html"
)
```

```{r actually-generate, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Actually generate the report for the pkgdown site
tryCatch({
  # Get the output directory where this HTML will be rendered
  output_file <- file.path(getwd(), "quality_control_report.html")
  
  generate_qc_report(
    contract_dt = bra_hrmis_contract,
    personnel_dt = bra_hrmis_personnel,
    est_dt = bra_hrmis_est,
    output = output_file
  )
  
  # Verify the file was created
  if (file.exists(output_file)) {
    message("✓ Quality control report generated at: ", output_file)
  } else {
    message("✗ Failed to create report at: ", output_file)
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  message("✗ Report generation error: ", e$message)
})
```
